messages.author: Trevor Kramer
messages.body:
Hello,
We are getting a urllib2.URLError: <urlopen error [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed (_ssl.c:727)> error when running the update_amber script. Did the certificate expire on the server?
Thanks,
Trevor Kramer
Relay Tx

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, Oct 03, 2023, Trevor Kramer via AMBER wrote:
>
>We are getting a urllib2.URLError: <urlopen error
>[SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed (_ssl.c:727)>
>error when running the update_amber script. Did the certificate expire on
>the server?
The certificate did indeed expire, and it has proved very difficult to get
this fixed.  I was told that a new certificate was up this morning, but
can't yet confirm that myself.  It may be that propagating the change will
take some time.  [I am personally pretty clueless about all of this security
and certificate stuff works.]
....dac
